title: [Bug] Max plan rate limiting: 5-hour usage limit exhausted after 3-5 requests
body:
**Bug Description**
  Description

  I'm on the Max plan (€100/month) and consistently hitting the 5-hour usage limit after just 3–5 requests. This is a severe regression
  compared to what I experienced previously.

  Expected behavior

  On the Max plan, which costs 5× more than Pro, I expect significantly more capacity. Previously, I could make ~50 requests of similar
  volume within a single 5-hour window without exhausting the limit — even on the Pro plan (€20/month).

  Actual behavior

  - The 5-hour limit is reached after only 3–5 requests
  - Requests are not unusually large — they are comparable in scope to what I was sending before
  - The effective capacity feels worse than what Pro offered at €20/month
  - This makes the Max plan essentially unusable for any sustained work session

  Impact

  - Cannot complete even basic development sessions without being rate-limited
  - Paying 5× more for what feels like less capacity
  - Forced to wait hours between small batches of work

  Environment

  - Plan: Max (€100/month)
  - Tool: Claude Code (CLI)
  - Model: Claude Opus 4.6

  Request

  Please investigate whether:
  1. There is a billing/tier misconfiguration affecting my account
  2. Rate limits have been silently reduced for Max plan users
  3. Token counting has changed in a way that inflates usage
  4. Opus 4.6 context/output tokens are being counted differently than before

  This level of capacity makes the Max plan not viable for professional use. I would appreciate transparency on what changed and a
  resolution.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: ghostty
- Version: 2.1.86
- Feedback ID: c2e2c5fd-0f39-4bb7-af82-4cf95f6bb203
